text: Cycling is a sport that offers a fun and healthy way to stay active. To ensure safety, it is essential to wear a helmet that protects the head from potential injuries in case of a fall. Additionally, cycling requires the use of gears to control the speed and efficiency of the ride, while the chain plays a crucial role in transmitting power from the pedals to the wheels. These components work together to make cycling a rewarding and enjoyable activity, regardless of the terrain. Whether you're riding through the city streets or tackling a challenging mountain trail, proper gear and equipment can help you ride safer, more efficiently, and with greater confidence.
summary: Cycling involves helmets for safety, gears for control, and chains for efficiency on varied terrains.
